app.title: Shipping rules
app.subtitle: Set up dynamic shipping rates for your store

ruleList.emptyBody: Create your first shipping rule to set up dynamic shipping rates.

ruleForm.name: Rule name
ruleForm.productTagsHelp: One tag is enough: products carrying at least one of these tags get this rule.
ruleForm.errorRates: Every shipping option needs a name

sync.heading: Sync with Shopify shipping settings
sync.never: Never synced — rules only take effect after the first sync.
sync.explanation: Your rules are written into your Shopify delivery profile as shipping rates (Settings → Shipping and delivery). Sync again after every rule change.
sync.tagProfiles: Tag rules: {created} delivery profile(s) created, {updated} updated, {removed} removed.

combined.heading: Combined shipping (multiple locations)
combined.explanation: When an order ships from more than one location (e.g. your own warehouse + a fulfillment partner), Shopify normally adds up both locations' shipping costs. Here you decide what the customer pays instead.
combined.needsDeployBody: The checkout function needs to be deployed once using the Shopify CLI:
combined.vendorHelp: This is how the app detects mixed orders: the vendor name on the fulfillment products (for Printful/Printify it's shown on the product page under Vendor).
combined.partnerRateHelp: What the partner charges per shipment (e.g. {example}). Mixed orders are discounted by this amount, minus any flat fee.
combined.modeHighestOnly: Charge only the highest rate (extra locations free)
combined.flatAmountHelp: Example: {example} — the customer pays the highest rate in full, and each extra location adds this flat amount.

billing.activeBody: Active plan: {plan}. All features are unlocked.
billing.inactiveBody: Choose a plan to keep using Shipping Rules. Billing is handled securely by Shopify — you'll be taken to Shopify's checkout page.
billing.noPricingUrl: You can open the plans in your Shopify admin under "Settings → Apps and sales channels → Shipping Rules".
